svg.title: TorchPairwise: four ways to compare, with streamed results
svg.desc: 87 comparison entries across 9 input families, including 13 kernels. All-pairs produces an N by M matrix, paired compares corresponding samples, condensed stores the strict upper triangle, and single compares two samples. Streamed operators compute tiles and accumulate reductions, selections or products without retaining the full generated comparison matrix. Schematics omit leading batch dimensions.
